# motherduck_owned_shares (Data Source)

Reads metadata for shares owned by the current MotherDuck account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "motherduck_owned_shares" "analytics" {
  name = "analytics_share"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of rows to return when the underlying MotherDuck catalog function supports limits.
- `name` (String) Optional exact object name filter.
- `offset` (Number) Number of rows to skip when the underlying MotherDuck catalog function supports offsets.

### Read-Only

- `rows` (Attributes List) Typed catalog rows for stable MotherDuck metadata. `rows_json` remains available for raw server columns. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rows))
- `rows_json` (String, Sensitive) Raw MotherDuck catalog rows encoded as JSON. Sensitive because catalog rows can include share URLs and account metadata.

<a id="nestedatt--rows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rows`

Read-Only:

- `access` (String) Share access mode.
- `created_ts` (String) Share creation timestamp.
- `include_pattern` (String) Catalog include patterns applied to the share.
- `name` (String) Share name.
- `source_database` (String) Database backing the share.
- `update_mode` (String) Share update mode.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) Share URL. This is sensitive because unrestricted share URLs can grant access.
- `visibility` (String) Share visibility mode.
